智能推荐的光效在显示结果时一直亮着
Mac 高刷新率屏幕上拖动截图选区更跟手

added: Email verification codes: connect a mailbox and codes from new emails are copied automatically (QQ, 163, Gmail, iCloud, Proton, or your own server)
On Mac, verification codes from texts forwarded by your iPhone are copied automatically and reach your other computers when sync is on
Clipboard groups, and smart suggestions: click the orb to get what you are most likely to paste next
Large preview for images in the clipboard
Let AI tools such as Claude and Cursor search your clipboard and OCR history (MCP, turn it on in Settings)
More translation services: Baidu, Caiyun, NiuTrans, Microsoft Azure, Tencent Cloud and Volcengine (with your own keys)
Add your own translators: an AI model, DeepLX, or any web API
Add images to AI chat with the plus button, by dragging them in, or by pasting; hover a thumbnail for a large view
Recorded GIFs now appear in the screenshot library
Optional frosted-glass style for the capture toolbar
A real-size preview next to Settings while adjusting the translation popup's appearance
Screenshot translation: choose which translation service to use (including your own)
After translating a screenshot, select and copy both the translation and the original with the mouse; moving the translated labels is now a Move toggle at the top right
improved: Redesigned screenshot translation animation: the lines being translated turn into shimmering placeholders, then the translation fades in line by line from the top
Screenshot translation goes into your interface language by default; mixed Chinese and English lines are translated separately, and text already in the target language is left as is
The translation popup now animates every time it opens and closes, with the frosted-glass background fading along (Windows)
A translation service that is rate-limited or times out is tried last for the next five minutes, so you don't wait on it every time
When devices can't find each other on the local network (for example with a TUN virtual adapter on), the app scans your subnet to find the host
The API address in AI settings is completed automatically (for example a missing /v1)
The clipboard panel's "⋯" menu and card button tips now match the app's style; the zoom level in image preview only shows while zooming
Rounded corners on the main window on Windows
AI answers fade in piece by piece with a trailing cursor and smooth scrolling; the thought process is collapsed by default
The selection dot appears where you release the mouse instead of a far corner, and no longer shows for links, file paths or code
The liquid-glass selection dot now refracts what is behind it, and its icon stays readable over dense text
Drag translation services to reorder them
Refined layout and motion in the translation popup
Redesigned clipboard cards, Settings and AI chat window
The smart-suggestion glow stays lit while results are shown
Dragging the capture selection keeps up better on high-refresh-rate Mac displays
fixed: "Test connection" for Gmail and some other mailboxes failed with "assertion failed", and codes weren't picked up in the background

Screenshot translation read button icons as characters and mixed them into the translation
A white ring occasionally appeared around the translation popup

Formatted text copied on a phone showed up as a file in the Mac clipboard
The selection dot's shadow was cut into a straight line, and repeated selections showed the previous dot inside the new one
Text behind the translation popup showed through the results with frosted glass off
A dark strip flashed at the top and bottom of the popup when opening AI chat
A faint halo was left at the four corners of frosted-glass panels
"Wrong device code" when pairing over the local network
